title: Manager, Product Management, Scheme and Regulatory Compliance
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Product Management, Scheme and Regulatory ComplianceOverview  
  
Mastercard Gateway, formerly known as MPGS, operates at the centre of the global payments ecosystem and supports customers across more than 70 countries. As an agnostic gateway serving acquirers, merchants, and partners globally, Mastercard Gateway must continuously respond to payment scheme mandates, regional regulatory requirements, and internal Mastercard compliance obligations.  
  
From a Gateway Scheme Compliance perspective, this role is critical to ensuring that scheme and regulatory changes are identified early, assessed accurately, prioritized effectively, and delivered within mandated timelines. The role supports the translation of scheme communications, announcements, bulletin into clear business impact assessments, product roadmap priorities, execution plans, and stakeholder communications that help reduce financial, operational, reputational risk.  
This role also supports gateway customers to gain benefit via reduced scheme fees, higher approval rates, and enable new MC product and services.
  
  
Role  
  
Reporting to the Director of Scheme Compliance, the role holder will support the Product Compliance function for the Mastercard Gateway product suite. The primary objective is to strengthen MPGS readiness for scheme mandates and regulatory obligations by driving disciplined intake, impact assessment, prioritization, governance, and execution tracking across the product lifecycle.  
  
The role will scan and analyse card scheme rules, bulletins, announcements, and mandates, assess applicability to MPGS, and convert these inputs into actionable roadmap items, compliance requirements, customer-impact assessments, and delivery priorities.  
The role will manage the collection, assessment, and prioritization of scheme compliance initiatives across Gateway, working closely with Global Product Management, Regional Product teams, Product Management-Technical, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Operations, and Customer-facing teams. The role will also support governance forums and PI Planning inputs to ensure compliance priorities are visible, understood, and reflected in delivery plans.  
  
The Compliance Product team is responsible for maintaining a structured relationship with Payment Schemes, including Mastercard, Visa, Amex, and other relevant networks, for receiving, analysing, clarifying, and operationalizing scheme bulletins and mandates.  
  
In addition, the role holder will support internal and external communication, training, and readiness activities for stakeholders and customers impacted by scheme or regulatory changes.  
  
Responsibilities  
  
Analyse card scheme communications, mandates, bulletins, and regulatory updates to identify applicability, business impact, customer impact, delivery risk, and compliance deadlines for Mastercard Gateway.  
Provide clear summaries of scheme rule changes and translate them into actionable requirements for impacted Gateway business areas.  
Partner with Product, PMT, Region, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Customer-facing teams to ensure required changes are prioritized and delivered within mandated timelines.  
Support roadmap planning and SAFe PI or Kanban Planning by ensuring scheme compliance priorities, dependencies, risks, and deadlines are clearly represented in delivery plans.  
Maintain a central repository of scheme communications, impact assessments, decisions, evidence, and delivery status for auditability and transparency.  
Build and maintain internal portals, trackers, and communication channels for scheme compliance updates and mandate visibility.  
Define, document, and continuously improve internal processes for scheme compliance intake, triage, assessment, governance, escalation, and closure with end to end ownership.  
Support MPGS business areas with scheme-related queries, clarifications, and interpretation of scheme requirements.  
Prepare internal and external communications, training material, customer readiness updates, and implementation guidance for impacted stakeholders.  
Liaise with payment networks and schemes where applicable to clarify requirements, represent MPGS considerations, and advocate appropriate Mastercard or customer positions.  
Identify and escalate compliance gaps, delivery risks, financial exposure, and customer impacts in a timely manner, with recommended remediation and communication plans.  
Use and bring AI efficiency in day-to-day work and in the compliance process which will add benefit to the Gateway and customers.
  
  
All About You  
  
8+ years of experience in Product Management, Payments, Scheme Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, Gateway products, Acquiring business, Merchant services, or related payments domains.  
Strong understanding of card schemes authorization & clearing modules, payment gateways, acquirers, merchants, acquiring banks, ecommerce, card present, digital and token payment flows.  
Experience interpreting scheme rules, mandates, bulletins, compliance requirements, and regulatory updates, with the ability to convert them into clear product requirement and delivery actions.  
Experience working with agile and Kanban delivery models, ideally including SAFe, PI Planning, backlog prioritization, dependency management, and cross-team execution tracking.  
Ability to build effective relationships across Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Regional, Commercial, Sales, Support, and Customer-facing teams.  
Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess business impact, delivery complexity, financial exposure, reputational risk, and customer implications.  
Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives across global teams and time zones.  
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to simplify complex scheme requirements for both technical and business audiences.  
Self-organized, self-driven with E2E ownership mindset, collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced global payments environment with evolving priorities and strict compliance deadlines.  
Knowledge on AI tools, AI agents and application like Aha, Confluence, Jira is essential.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
**Designation**- Brand Marketing Manager
  
  
**Experience** - 5 Years
  
  
**Position Description** – Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it's equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.
  
In the capacity of a Brand Marketing Manager, you will ensure the efficient execution of business plans to meet future brand expectations and targets. You will also take part in the development of short-term tactical Brand Management marketing plans. You will ensure brand integrity by guiding efforts across multiple channels and functions and support the development and execution of offline, digital, and paid social advertising programs for the business.
  
The role entails the management of media campaigns from the beginning to the end and is also responsible for the execution across all media channels inclusive of TV, Radio, Digital, Print, and Paid Social. The Brand Marketing Manager reports directly to the Director- Womennovator.
  
  
**The Impact You'll Make in this Role** -
  
  
**Strategy :** You will play part in the development of the brand marketing strategies in order to establish strategic direction and program positioning. In this capacity, the Brand Marketing Manager, you will develop marketing partnerships with media partners, and other external partners in an attempt to broaden the reach of the business’s brand messaging.
  
You will also play part in the development and execution of paid social programs on advertising platforms inclusive of Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, and Twitter etc. along with supporting the brand’s paid media programs. At this capacity, you will contribute to the development and execution of all online/offline events, promotions for the business/brand.
  
  
**Management:** You will play a managerial role in the production process for all offline marketing materials, for example, project timelines, and so forth. You will be tasked with the maintenance of the lower department’s operational production budget, ensuring that there is a continuous effective and economical allocation of resources. You will also supervises multiple external agencies in developing creative advertising, high-impact promotions, and media planning,event sponsorship.
  
You will additionally manage media timelines and executes plans across all media channels, that is, TV, Social, Radio, and Print etc. you will effectively supervisethe junior marketing staff/team, managing workflow, providing direction, and overseeing constant skill development. You will strike a balance in ensuring all branding and key information strategies are in line with overall business strategy without compromising the brand’s integrity.
  
  
**Collaboration:** You will work closely with Director, in reviewing and approving all branded elements for advertising and launch materials inclusive of printed collateral, product packaging, online assets, launch toolkits, product logos, and videos etc..
  
In this collaboration, he/she also provides feedback and insight on the performance of program campaigns and relays them for further strategic development and solution formulation. You will serves as a collaborative partner and liaison between all internal product departments in ensuring integrated campaigns and cohesive strategies. Youwill also be tasked with collaborating with external partners in ensuring that all media plans are aligned with the business’s values and goals, are executed on-time and on-budget.
  
  
**Analytics:** You will also play an analytical role where you will conduct research and analyses, translating campaign performance into communication documents and reports, which are distributed to management and key stakeholders. Some of these documents are marketing briefs, competitive analyses, campaign recap decks, and so forth.
  
At this capacity, You will track spending on all media campaigns for the purpose of ensuring that brand marketing efforts always stay within the allocated budget. Here, you will actualize cost reports per project at the completion of each brand marketing campaign. You will prepare account management, expenditure, progress, and other related reports. Additionally, you will review targeted spends and make real-time adjustments to optimize brand marketing campaign performance.
  
  
**Knowledge and Opportunity:** You will also conduct regular and consistent research and keep the business and the brand marketing department informed on best practices and the latest trends in brand marketing that ensure that the business does not lag behind of its competition and also in order to provide growth opportunity for the brand by capitalizing on the acquisition potential that alternative branding strategies/approaches may hold.
  
At this capacity, you will ensure that the product/service maintains a consistent tone that is relevant to the business’s brand and the audience, solidifying the brand identity by ensuring consistent, on-time and accurate development, deliveryfor each brand marketing campaign.
  
  
**Other Duties:** You will also performs other tasks as designated by the Director.
  
  
**To set you up for success in this role from day one, Womennovator is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:**  
  
  

* MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing (Completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited university

* Five (5) combined years’ experience in brand management or integrated marketing

* Three (3) years people leadership experience

* Strong communications (written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal) skills, including tact, diplomacy, and ability to influence and navigate across a diverse and complex organization.

* Highly proficient in Ms Word, PowerPoint, and Ms Excel

  
**Age:** Preferably below 35 years as on the closing date for receipt of application

title: Sr Operations Analyst, Services
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  
  
For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  
  
Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

**Title** : Sr Operations Analyst

**Reporting to:** Director, GTM Operations

**Location** : Bangalore, India

**Department** : Sales Operations

  
  

**Overview**

Quickbase is seeking a Senior Analyst, Services Operations to serve as the lead operations partner for our Professional Services organization. Your primary charter is to make services delivery repeatable and predictable, its impact on customer outcomes measurable, and its capacity planning.

You will partner with the Services leadership team to define the frameworks, metrics, and models that we use to run the business. Your work will directly shape how we measure customer time to value, how we decide where to invest in services, and how our customer success teams recommend services to customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations Partnership with Services Leadership**

Your primary relationship is with the Services senior leadership team. You are their operations partner for planning, measurement, and decision support — bringing structure and evidence to capacity decisions, investment cases, delivery performance reviews, and the operating cadence that runs the business. When Services leadership needs to know how the organization is performing or what to do next, you are the first call.

From there, you extend that support into the delivery organization, tailoring what you build to how each role works, including Project Managers, Solution Architects, Technical Consultants, and Technical Account Managers.

**Systems & Requirements Ownership**

* Partner with the development team behind our professional services automation (PSA) platform to understand the product roadmap and translate it into downstream operational impact, including effects on customer success systems and workflows

* Own requirements gathering and definition with Services leadership, and carry those requirements proactively to our data and analytics team for implementation in our data warehouse and BI layer

**Customer Outcome & Services Effectiveness Analytics**

* Build the analytical framework for time to value on services engagements — definition, instrumentation, and segmentation by package, customer segment, and engagement type

* Assess the effectiveness of prior services investment through a customer outcome lens: adoption depth, retention and expansion, and support load reduction for serviced vs. non-serviced accounts

* Define the customer-success-facing services metric set — the signals that tell a Customer Success Manager when to recommend a services engagement, which package fits a given account, where in the customer lifecycle it lands best, and what outcome to hold the engagement to afterward

* Identify repeatable delivery practices that accelerate customer value realization, and convert those findings into operational changes — playbook triggers, customer success plays, and scoping guidance

**Forecasting & Capacity Planning**

* Build services forecasting frameworks by package, with a clear structural distinction between revenue-generating services and services delivered as investment — these behave differently and should never be reported as one number

* Partner with FP&A to feed operational forecasts into capacity modeling and investment and hiring decisions, owning forecast volume, package mix, delivery capacity, and demand signal

**Automation, AI & Enablement**

* Identify, scope, and shepherd AI and automation use cases for Services — project status summarization, engagement artifact generation, and automated project health flagging — to give time back to the delivery team

* Partner with Enablement to define standard operating procedures that set clear expectations for team members, ensuring each procedure maps to an actual step in our systems rather than living only in a document

**New Offering Readiness**

* Own operational readiness for new services offerings and packages coming to market, including entitlement reporting impact, services intake changes, KPI and reporting implications, and pre-launch readiness review

**Required Experience**

* 4–6 years in Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or Services Operations, including direct experience supporting a professional services, consulting, or delivery organization

* Working knowledge of professional services operating mechanics — utilization, bookings-to-delivery, backlog, resource capacity, and scoping accuracy — and the practical difference between revenue-generating services and investment services

* Experience with professional services automation (PSA) tooling and how it integrates with CRM and customer success platforms

* Experience building forecasting or capacity models and partnering with Finance on how those models are used

* Demonstrated analytical rigor on outcome questions — able to structure a defensible comparison, such as serviced vs. non-serviced customer cohorts, and defend it to an executive audience

Comfortable specifying requirements against a data warehouse and BI environment (e.g., Snowflake, Power BI) without owning the build

We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
  
**How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

* **Unlock profitable scale.** Find the games ready to grow faster, and move quickly when something isn’t paying back.
* **Keep targets sharp.** Work with our analytics team on LTV and ROAS targets, and bring a healthy challenge when the numbers don’t add up.

* Profitable spend and installs at or above target payback
* ROAS and payback against target
* UA contribution to profit across the portfolio
* How quickly budget moves to the best opportunities
* A happy, growing UA team

* Senior UA experience in mobile games, with F2P titles you’ve scaled profitably across ad networks and social channels.
* Experience leading or mentoring UA Managers.
* A strong grasp of ROAS, payback, LTV and cohort analysis, and of measurement in today’s privacy- first world.
* A love of creative testing, and a feel for what makes an ad win on different channels.
* Great commercial judgement: you can explain every budget decision in pounds.
* Happy to get hands-on with campaigns, spreadsheets, and BI tools.
* A clear, confident communicator who brings people along with evidence.

**Desirable**

* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set

title: Content strategist & Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role

We are building a fast-moving creative team in Gurgaon working across **Socialshifu, personal brands, and client accounts**.

We are looking for a **Content Strategist & Social Media Manager** who can take ownership of the complete content process — from deciding what should be created to getting it produced, scheduled and published.

This is not a traditional "post on Instagram" social media role.

We want someone who understands **content, storytelling, social media and audience behaviour**, and can turn ideas into a consistent daily content system.

What You'll Be Responsible For

**1. Content Strategy**

* Build weekly and monthly content calendars.
* Develop content pillars for each account.
* Identify what topics, formats and ideas should be explored.
* Turn current events, conversations, trends and brand activities into content opportunities.
* Develop recurring content series rather than relying only on random posts.

**2. Content Ideation**

* Generate Reel, Story, Carousel, LinkedIn and Short-form content ideas.
* Write strong hooks and content angles.
* Think about how the first 2–3 seconds of a Reel should work.
* Understand what makes people stop, watch, share and follow.
* Work closely with the Founder/Creative Director on larger creative ideas.

**3. Scripting & Briefing**

* Write or develop short-form scripts.
* Create clear briefs for video editors.
* Tell editors what footage, B-roll, references, text, pacing and structure are required.
* Convert one idea into multiple pieces of content when possible.

**4. Social Media Management**

* Manage day-to-day publishing across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Schedule posts.
* Write captions and CTAs.
* Maintain posting consistency.
* Manage Stories and supporting content.
* Ensure every piece of content is published correctly and on time.

**5. Coordinate the Editors**  
You will work directly with our two video editors.

You will:

* Assign content.
* Give editing briefs.
* Set deadlines.
* Review first cuts.
* Give feedback.
* Ensure revisions are completed.
* Maintain the content pipeline.

You should be able to say:

"These are the 10 pieces we need this week. These 4 go to Editor A, these 6 go to Editor B, these 2 need fresh footage, and these 3 are ready to schedule."

**6. Content Performance**

* Track views, watch time, retention, shares, saves, comments, profile visits and follower growth.
* Identify which hooks and formats are working.
* Learn from performance rather than blindly following trends.
* Adjust the next week's content based on data.

**7. Content Repurposing**  
One shoot or piece of content should not necessarily become only one post.

You should look for opportunities to turn:

* One interview → multiple Reels
* One event → Reels + Stories + photos + LinkedIn
* One long video → multiple Shorts
* One idea → multiple content formats

Accounts You'll Work On

Initially, you may work across three different types of accounts:

**Socialshifu**

* Our own brand.
* AI-powered content and advertising.
* Startup/product storytelling.
* Creative work and portfolio.

**Personal Brand**

* Build authority and credibility.
* Business/networking content.
* Meetings, events, insights and relationships.
* Content that strengthens his personal brand.

**Client Account**

* A professional client account where content quality, consistency and approvals are critical.

Each account has a different objective, so you should understand that **the same content strategy cannot be copied across every account.**

What We're Looking For

We care more about **thinking ability and execution** than certificates.

You should:

* Understand Instagram and short-form content deeply.
* Have strong content instincts.
* Be able to write good hooks and scripts.
* Understand storytelling.
* Have a good sense of trends without blindly copying them.
* Understand basic analytics.
* Be highly organised.
* Be comfortable managing multiple content calendars.
* Communicate clearly with editors and creatives.
* Take ownership of deadlines.
* Be proactive rather than waiting for instructions.
* Have strong attention to detail.
* Be comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment.

The Most Important Quality

**Ownership.**

We are not looking for someone who needs to be told every morning what to do.

We want someone who can look at the accounts and say:

"This is what we should publish this week, this is why, these are the assets we need, and this is how we're going to execute it."

You will have creative direction and support from the founder, but you should be capable of **running the day-to-day content operation independently.**

Who This Role Is NOT For

This may not be the right role if your experience is mainly:

* Uploading posts
* Copy-pasting captions
* Canva-only social media work
* Waiting for someone to provide every idea
* Following trends without understanding them
* Managing only one small account
* Needing constant supervision

Preferred Experience

**1–3+ years** in social media, content, digital marketing, creator management or a similar role is preferred.

However, **strong portfolio > years of experience**.

Someone with 1 year of excellent work can be more valuable than someone with 4 years of average work.

Practical Hiring Task

Shortlisted candidates will be given a practical assignment:

You will receive three different accounts and will be asked to create a **7-day content plan** including:

* Content ideas
* Hooks
* Formats
* Posting schedule
* Basic scripts
* Content pillars
* Editor requirements
* Reasoning behind your choices

We want to see **how you think**, not just what is written on your CV.

Location

**Gurgaon, Haryana**

**On-site role**

We are building a small creative studio environment and this role will work closely with the founders and creative team.

Compensation

**₹30,000–₹40,000/month**, depending on experience, portfolio and execution ability.

Exceptional candidates may be considered separately.

Team Structure

You will work closely with:

**Founder / Creative Director**  
Creative direction, business, client relationships and major campaign ideas.

**Video Editor 1**  
High-volume social content and Reels.

**Video Editor 2**  
Creative/AI-powered advertising and premium content.

**Freelance Shooters**  
On-location production when required.

The Goal

Your job is ultimately to build a **content engine**.

Not just:

"Post every day."

But:

Idea → Strategy → Script → Production → Editing → Approval → Publishing → Analytics → Learning → Next Idea.

You will own that pipeline.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

title: UX Researcher | India
description:
**About AnswerLab**

AnswerLab helps pioneering leaders Own the Unknown, transforming uncharted territory into clarity, direction, and competitive advantage. We build strategic insight through deep human understanding and validating future possibilities with real people in real contexts. We believe that the future of experience strategy relies on continuous learning and cross-functional expertise, enabling us to guide clients through unprecedented challenges across every phase of the product lifecycle.

**Role Summary**

As a UX Researcher, you will join our Rapid Research program, a dedicated, embedded research team that delivers fast, high-quality insights (typically within 1–2 weeks) to a major global technology client.

Rapid Researchers are based across the US, EMEA (UK, Zurich), and APAC (India, Korea), providing global research coverage for the client's key audiences, including General Populations, Content Creators, Teens, and accessibility-focused populations.

This remote role is based in India and adds dedicated coverage and Hindi-language research capabilities to the program, enabling the team to conduct research with both Hindi and English-speaking participants, and to better support stakeholders across the region and in other international markets, including US-based stakeholders.

You'll spend the majority of your time leading Rapid Research studies end-to-end, with the opportunity to contribute to longer-form Custom Research projects (e.g., diary studies, benchmarking, or focus groups), as needed.

You are passionate about research: you love learning new methods, testing new tools and technologies, and thinking deeply about the human-centered issues we face as researchers. You see yourself as a partner to stakeholders, bringing them into the research process and listening closely to their needs.

You're proactive, adaptable, and organized, with time management skills to keep multiple fast-moving studies on track simultaneously. Rapid Researchers are typically prepping their next study while fielding and reporting on the current one.

Ideal candidates have at least 4 years of hands-on experience leading research studies and partnering with stakeholders or clients throughout the research process.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Rapid Research Delivery

* Lead Rapid Research studies end-to-end, delivering fast, high-quality insights within a 1–2 week (or accelerated 1-week sprint) timeframe.
* Consult on research methodology and scope, and develop kickoff/alignment documents and moderator guides
* Moderate remote and in-person interviews (In-Depth Interviews, unmoderated studies, heuristic evaluations) with Viewers, Creators, Teens, or accessibility-focused participants
* Conduct literature reviews and competitive analyses as needed
* Deliver end-of-day session summaries during fielding and lead key-takeaway alignment with stakeholders
* Analyze findings and develop final reports (slide decks of ~30 slides, or written docs) with clear, actionable recommendations
* Present findings in stakeholder readouts

  

2. Client Stakeholder Partnership

* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, bringing consultative guidance to every study.
* Provide consultative guidance and proactively recommend solutions to keep research moving forward
* Coordinate closely with the recruiting team on participant screening and scheduling, flagging special or advanced recruit needs early
* Support Hindi-language studies and localization needs, serving as a regional point of contact for India specific research questions

  

3. Program & Process Excellence

* Keep projects on track and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Rapid Research program.
* Keep projects on schedule and within scope, managing multiple concurrent studies at different stages (prep, fielding, reporting)
* Explore creative solutions to research challenges, including recommending improvements to internal processes or best practices
* Continue developing your research and consultative skills, and contribute to AnswerLab's knowledge library and internal training initiatives
* Contribute to Custom Research projects (2+ week timelines) as a nice-to-have, such as focus groups, diary studies, benchmarking, surveys, card sorting, contextual inquiry, or Critical User Journey (CUJ) audits

  

**Key Relationships**

* Reports to: Research Manager (UK-based)
* Close collaboration with: UX Research peers across all markets (APAC, EMEA, US), Research Manager (US-based), Project Manager
* Client engagement: Active coordination with client stakeholders

  

**Knowledge, Skills, & Experience**

We know outstanding candidates come from a range of backgrounds. We are looking for people with the personal characteristics to thrive in a growing, client-focused, purpose-driven business. The ideal candidate will meet many of the criteria below.

**Experience**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience conducting qualitative UX or market research, including experience leading studies end-to-end
* Native/fluent fluency in Hindi and business-level fluency in English, with the ability to moderate research sessions and write deliverables in both languages
* Experience partnering with clients/stakeholders in a consulting or agency environment, or an equivalent research background
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities across concurrent studies, and meet fast-moving deadlines

  

**Research Craft**

Skilled in core Rapid Research methodologies:

* In-depth interviews
* Unmoderated studies
* Heuristic evaluation
* Literature review
* Competitive analysis

Familiarity with a broader range of methodologies is a nice-to-have:

  

* Focus groups
* Diary studies
* Benchmarking
* Surveys
* Card sorting
* Contextual inquiry
* Critical User Journeys
* Strong presentation skills, including building decks and presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders

  

**Organization & Communication**

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and completeness
* Exceptional time management skills with the ability to prioritize effectively across competing demands
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities
* Comfortable using online/remote research tools (e.g., Google Meet, Zoom, dscout, GSuite)
* Responsive, service-oriented, and client-focused in all interactions

  

**Mindset & Values**

* Curious, enthusiastic, and energized by a fast-paced, problem-solving environment
* Self-motivated, quick learner who thrives with minimal supervision
* Collaborative team player with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through
* Committed to inclusive, empathetic collaboration and contributing to a workplace where diverse talent thrives

  

**Education**

Undergraduate and/or advanced degree, preferably in:

* Experimental Psychology
* Cognitive Psychology
* Human Factors
* Human-Computer Interaction
* Or a related field with a foundation in research-based design

  

**Additional Requirements**

Willingness to collaborate across multiple time zones (e.g., APAC, EMEA, and US-based partners), which may occasionally require scheduling flexibility and extended hours to meet project deadlines

Ability to work at a computer for extended periods of time

**Location Eligibility**

Home-based/remote, located in India, with up to 15% travel (including occasional in-person sessions at regional lab spaces)

Must be comfortable leading projects independently and collaborating virtually across APAC, EMEA, and US time zones, which may occasionally require schedule flexibility

Candidates must have current work authorization in India; AnswerLab cannot sponsor visas for this role.

No staffing or recruiting agencies.

* **Advocate for the User:** Turn research findings into meaningful product changes, ensuring the "voice of the customer" is the loudest voice in the room. You’ll decide what a traveler needs to know and when, and cut the copy that serves the business rather than the customer.

### **Scale the Vision**

* **Evolve the System:** Contribute patterns to Horizon properly, with their states, variants, accessibility notes, and reasoning, and then get other teams actually using them. So every team can build faster on shared standards.
* **Iterate with Data:** Help design the test, not just the screen in it. You’ll bring the hypothesis, the metric that should move, the metric that mustn’t get worse, and what result would make you drop the idea.

**Who you are:**

* You have 3+ years of experience in Product/UX design, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-step digital products, including at least one project where AI was materially part of how you worked.
* **Hands-on with modern AI workflows:** You use AI across your design lifecycle and can show us where, in the files: what you generated, what you overrode, and one thing it got plausibly wrong that you caught.
* **Comfortable Being Measured:** You’re at home in an experimentation culture. You form a hypothesis before you ship, you know what a guardrail metric is for, and you’d rather be proven wrong in two weeks than go unchallenged for a year.
* **Problem-Framing Over Problem-Solving:** You don’t just design screens; you decide which problem is worth designing for, get your partners aligned on it, and turn down work that won’t change anything.
* **Influence Without Authority:** You change minds by building the demo, bringing the proof, and picking the moment. You can lose an argument without sulking and come back with better evidence.
* **Accessibility and Real-World Design:** You design for edge cases as a matter of course: screen readers, low connectivity, high-stress travel. You catch accessibility problems in other people’s work during critique.
* **Systems Thinking in Figma:** Deeply fluent in Figma, thinking natively in tokens, variants, and component architecture so design decisions scale across platforms.
* **Distributed by Default:** You work well with partners in other offices and time zones, write things down, and keep a problem moving without needing everyone in the room.

* Identify and unlock white-space growth opportunities within existing Quick Commerce accounts to drive sustainable, market-beating performance.

* Spearhead cross-brand and cross-category activations, including strategic partnerships with external brands to maximize consumer reach and engagement.

* Own and accelerate the content-to-commerce funnel, closely collaborating with performance marketing and brand teams to maximize ROI and conversion.

**We Are Looking For:**  
To succeed in this role, you should bring proven experience in trade marketing, brand marketing, or digital e-commerce activations, preferably within the FMCG, Retail or beauty sectors. A deep, practical familiarity with the quick commerce landscape is highly valued.
  
  
**You’re a great match for this role if you have:**  

* Commercial & Creative Vision: You possess a powerful blend of commercial acumen and creative marketing skills to capture instant consumer attention.
* Analytical & Data Acumen: You are highly analytical, with a data-driven mindset and deep expertise in performance marketing and content-to-commerce metrics.

**Joining Arup**

Arup is an UK-headquartered independent firm with 92 offices in 34 countries and 18,000+ staff across the globe. Arup Digital Products (ADP) are seeking a Product Manager to lead the strategy, development and delivery of AI and Machine Learning capabilities across Arup’s engineering simulation software portfolio. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

* Demonstrable experience owning and delivering software products across the full product lifecycle, including discovery, delivery and launch.
* Experience working with AI/ML technologies in a product context, with a strong conceptual understanding of techniques, data requirements, evaluation, validation and practical deployment considerations.
* The ability to translate complex technical and CAE workflow requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and value-led product narratives.
* Hands-on experience with agile development methodologies, cross-functional delivery teams and evidence-based prioritisation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences, senior stakeholders and international customers.

We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. title: Java - Full Stack Observability Engineer, AVP
description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are seeking a hands-on Observability Engineer with strong full-stack software engineering experience and deep expertise in Dynatrace. In this role, full stack means the ability to work across application code, telemetry instrumentation, observability platform configuration, dashboards, alerting, and automation workflows. The ideal candidate will help design, implement, and optimize observability solutions across enterprise SaaS and on-premises environments, enabling proactive monitoring, faster root-cause analysis, and automation-assisted remediation. This position requires excellent communication, analytical, and technical skills, along with the ability to partner effectively with SaaS operations, product, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams.

  
  

**What you will be doing**

You will own and advance observability enablement for key Charles River services, including implementation standards, telemetry patterns, dashboards, alert quality, and adoption support. Working with SaaS, product, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams, you will design and implement tooling that improves visibility into service health, performance, availability, and client-impacting issues. This role is critical to strengthening operational readiness and ensuring Charles River products can be monitored, observed, and proactively supported across client environments.

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is part of the Charles River Investment Management Solution (CRIMS), a market-leading end-to-end investment management platform covering front, middle, and back office capabilities. Charles River IMS supports portfolio management, compliance, order and execution management, post-trade processing, data provisioning and management, performance measurement, and other capabilities central to the investment lifecycle. The Observability Engineer plays a key role in ensuring visibility into the performance, stability, and availability of the platform so teams can identify issues earlier, reduce operational risk, and improve the client experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Dynatrace implementation and optimization**

* Implement, configure, and optimize Dynatrace monitoring solutions across SaaS and on-premises environments.
* Build and maintain Dynatrace Dashboards Gen 3 for unified visibility, executive reporting, and operational insights.
* Use Dynatrace SaaS, Grail, DQL, Davis AI, OneAgent, OpenTelemetry, synthetic monitoring, and real user monitoring where appropriate to improve observability coverage.
* Develop reusable implementation patterns and standards that enable consistent telemetry collection across critical services.
  

  

**Monitoring, alerting, and incident insight**

* Define log-based alerts, service-level indicators, trace-log correlation, batch metrics, and alert-quality standards for production services.
* Integrate Dynatrace with external systems, including Azure Event Hub or similar event-publishing platforms, to support downstream workflows and operational reporting.
* Improve root-cause analysis by correlating application, infrastructure, log, trace, metric, and user-experience signals.
  

  

**Performance and reliability engineering**

* Conduct performance impact assessments using custom service detection rules, distributed traces, logs, and service health data.
* Partner with SRE, product, technical support, and engineering teams to ensure observability coverage for critical services and client-facing workflows.
* Support automation-assisted remediation by connecting observability insights to approved automation workflows where appropriate.
  

  

**Training, documentation, and enablement**

* Lead training sessions for SaaS, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams on Dynatrace usage, dashboard interpretation, and observability best practices.
* Develop documentation, onboarding materials, reference implementations, and dashboard templates for observability tools.
* Promote adoption of observability standards across teams by translating technical telemetry into actionable operational guidance.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience designing, developing, implementing, or operating enterprise software systems and applications.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in observability, application performance monitoring, synthetic monitoring, telemetry instrumentation, dashboards, alerting, and trend analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Dynatrace SaaS, DQL, Logs on Grail, Dashboards Gen 3, and related Dynatrace capabilities.
* Strong Java or JVM-based engineering experience, including the ability to understand application behavior, instrumentation needs, and production performance characteristics.
* Experience with distributed systems, microservices, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and production support practices.
* Experience with log ingestion, trace correlation, service detection, metrics, and real user monitoring.
* Ability to collaborate with engineering, SRE, SaaS operations, technical support, product, and client-facing teams to translate observability data into actionable insight.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to both engineering and operational stakeholders.
  

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with React or other frontend frameworks, especially for frontend observability, real user monitoring, and user-experience diagnostics.

JOB ID: R-256479 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 01, 2026 CATEGORY: Strategy and Innovation

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

  
  

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

  
  

**Digital Product Manager (AI)** The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.

  
  

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.
  
  
This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.

  
  

**What You’ll Do**

* **Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability,** feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.

* Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.

* Assess how **LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics,** and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.

* Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.

* Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.

* Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.

* Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.

* Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.

* **Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory** considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.

* **Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, prioritization discussions, technical feasibility reviews, user experience design, process mapping, and decision forums. Communicate complex AI and data concepts in a clear, business-oriented way for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 8-13 years of work experience in the related field
* Doctorate; or Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or

* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or

* Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or

* High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of product management, product strategy, innovation, consulting, digital transformation, or related experience.

* 2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions.

* Working knowledge of **AI product development**, **including discovery, prototyping, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.**

* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.

* Design thinking experience

* Ability to evaluate AI opportunities across desirability, feasibility, viability, value, risk, scalability, and data readiness.

* Experience with AI platforms, MLOps, or enterprise AI architecture.

* Familiarity with AI (e.g., LLMs, agents, NLP) and ML productization at scale.

* Strong presentation and public speaking skills with experience communicating to executives

* Familiarity with biotech workflows (e.g., lab automation, computational biology, clinical data, etc).

* Hands-on ability to analyze product usage, model output quality, or design A/B experiments.

* Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments where priorities evolve quickly.

* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and levels.

* Consulting experience, with demonstrated ability to structure and solve complex business problems.

* Experience conducting cross-industry landscape assessments to identify how AI is being leveraged to address shared problem spaces and uncover macro-level trends and opportunities

title: Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Risk
description:
**About Tala**

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.
  
  
The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

### **The Role**

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for aSenior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

### **What You'll Do**

### **Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy**

* Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
* Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
* Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

### **Build Data-Driven Fraud Products**

* Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
* Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
* Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
* Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
* Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

### **Lead Product Execution**

* Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
* Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
* Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
* Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
* Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

### **Manage Fraud & Risk Events**

* Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
* Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
* Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.

### **Collaborate Across Tala**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
* Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
* Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.

### **What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
* Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.
* Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience managing fraud incidents, emerging fraud patterns, or other high-impact risk events.
* Ability to translate complex and ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
* Experience managing external vendors or technology partners.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, distributed, and highly collaborative environment.

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Product Owner, Workday, Compensation & Advance Compensation
description:
**Position Overview**  
  
The **Experienced Product Owner** is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the **Total Rewards: Compensation & Advance Compensation** Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

  

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): **Compensation & Advance Compensation** end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

  

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

  

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to configure, test, validate and deploy.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Create design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Own day-to-day delivery.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

  

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role): Compensation & Advanced Compensation**  
  
Salary structures, merit and bonus planning, compensation cycles, and global pay practices — configuration and operational support.

* **Compensation Structures:** Grade profiles, salary ranges, pay bands, compensation plans (salary, hourly, allowance), and eligibility rules.
* **Merit & Bonus Planning:** Merit matrices, bonus plan configuration, target amounts, proration rules, and manager worksheet setup.
* **Compensation Cycles:** Annual and off-cycle review configuration, approval routing, budget pools, and cycle administration.
* **Advanced Compensation:** Long-term incentive plans, equity award management, one-time payments, and complex plan eligibility.
* **Global Pay Practices:** Multi-currency compensation, country-specific allowances, cost-of-living adjustments, and grade localization.
* **Integrations & Reporting:** Payroll input mapping, compensation statement generation, comp data audits, and Prism-ready pay analytics

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

**About Revantage**  
  
Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.  
  
Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

You'll set direction in partnership with the Product Lead, run discovery and delivery across multiple workstreams, and bring deep procurement domain expertise to every decision, all while ensuring trust, adoption, and business impact for enterprise users.

This is a builder's role with real ownership: you're accountable not just for what your team ships, but for the vision, prioritization, and people behind it. **Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, and take a lead role — alongside the Product Lead — in shaping the 12–18 month vision and strategy

* Define and own the KPIs that prove impact: adoption, efficiency gains, cost reduction, supplier performance, and workflow completion
* Know when something isn't working — flag it early, make the case to change course, and retire low-value work fast

**Discover & Validate**

* Lead discovery to understand procurement practitioners, category managers, and finance stakeholders, and translate what you hear into prioritized, high-value use cases

* Use generative and evaluative research to continuously answer "are we building the right thing?" and "are we building it right?"

* Take features and agent capabilities from concept through define, shape, build, and scale

* Run sprint planning, reviews, and the daily cadence that keeps delivery moving with engineering, data science, and design
* Own launch, adoption, and iteration — instrument the product and act on what the telemetry and voice-of-customer data show
* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery

**Trust & Governance**

* Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to define evaluation approach, monitoring plans, auditability, and governance requirements aligned to the Trustworthy AI™ framework
* Own trust and audit-readiness outcomes for your product area, including policy adherence and reduction of high-severity model risks

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Own go-to-market inputs for your area: positioning, pricing/packaging input, demos, and enablement, partnering with sales, alliances, and delivery on pursuits, pilots, and launches

description:
**Level Up Your Career!**

At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.

At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.

**Join the team!**  

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior or Lead Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.

We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* **Understand the games inside out.** Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* **Start with a hypothesis.** Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* **Run experiments that decide.** Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* **Connect growth and product.** Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* **Grow the product craft.** Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* **Spot tomorrow’s hits.** Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

### **What You’ll Own:**

Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

**How we’ll celebrate your success:**

* Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
* Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
* Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
* Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

### **What We’re Looking For:**

**Essential**

* Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.
* Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.
* A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.
* Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads
* A clear, warm communicator who makes the case in players and pounds.

**Desirable**

* SQL experience.
* Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.
* Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience

### **Why Kwalee?**

* **Generous Holiday:** Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* **Flexible Working:** We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* **Health Cover:** Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* **Free Food & Drink:** Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* **Gaming Goodies:** Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* **Transport:** Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* **Office Location:** Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* **Merch & Events:** Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

### **Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. The Digital Services AI Product team is building the foundation for the next generation of help experiences on eBay. We are focused on making support personalized, effortless, fast, and trusted, providing seamless help where and when customers need it.
