title: SAP FICO PM
description:
Role: SAP FICO PM  
Function: Enterprise Technology Solutions – Finance Products, Europe  
Experience: 10–14 years in SAP Finance, including 4+ years owning solution design and delivery of change through a partner-led development team  
Reporting to: Finance Products Lead, Europe

Role Purpose

Own the SAP Finance (FICO) product for Europe on the build-and-change side. The role is the accountable interface between European Finance business users and the Accenture development pod: converting business demand into the right solution design, getting it built and released on time and to quality, and owning every dependency the partner team will not own — integration, cross-functional, data, security and infrastructure.

This is a product ownership role, not a coordination role. The person is expected to have an opinion on the design, to say no to the wrong design, and to be credible in front of both a Finance Controller and an Accenture solution architect.

Key Responsibilities

Demand and solution design ownership

* Own the European Finance change pipeline end to end: intake, qualification, business case challenge, solution option analysis, prioritisation with process owners, and release planning.
* Work with business users and process owners to get to the *best* solution rather than the first one proposed — standard SAP over custom, global template over local workaround, reuse over rebuild. Document and defend the rationale.
* Review and sign off functional specifications, solution design documents and architecture decisions produced by the Accenture solution managers before build starts; ensure design fits the global template, the S/4HANA roadmap and the enterprise architecture guardrails.
* Assess and challenge impact on adjacent processes — O2C, P2P, R2R, tax, treasury, costing, intercompany, statutory and group reporting — before committing to a design.
* Maintain the product backlog, roadmap and release calendar for Finance applications in Europe, with clear prioritisation logic visible to stakeholders.

Managing the Accenture delivery team

* Manage the Accenture pod covering solution managers, functional consultants, developers and testers: work allocation, sprint or release commitments, estimate review, dependency clearing and progress tracking.
* Hold the partner accountable for design quality, build quality, unit testing, documentation and on-time delivery; review estimates critically and challenge padding, scope creep and rebadged effort.
* Run the delivery governance cadence — design authority reviews, daily/weekly stand-ups, sprint or release reviews, defect triage, go/no-go decisions — and escalate early when a date is at risk.
* Own the quality gates the partner delivers into: design review, code review/ATC, SIT, UAT entry and exit criteria, cutover readiness and hypercare exit.
* Drive knowledge retention, documentation standards and reduced key-person dependency across the pod; sign off knowledge transfer before resource rotation.

Cross-team liaison (dependencies outside the partner scope)

This is a core part of the role, not an occasional extra. The Accenture team will not own these; the Product Manager does.

* Integration / BTP team — specify and drive interface requirements, iFlow design on SAP Integration Suite/CPI, API and event design, error handling and monitoring (AIF), interface testing windows and cutover sequencing.
* Data and MDM teams — master data readiness, data quality rules, migration and conversion objects, ownership of data-related design decisions.
* Security and GRC — role design, segregation-of-duties impact, access approvals and audit/SOX evidence for changes.
* Basis / infrastructure / transport management — landscape availability, transport sequencing across releases, system refresh impact on in-flight change.
* Other functional product teams and regional/global template owners — cross-module dependencies, template change requests, alignment where a European requirement touches the global core.
* Third-party and downstream systems — banking, tax engines, consolidation and reporting platforms, local statutory tools.
* Own the dependency and risk register for the Finance product; chase, unblock and escalate rather than waiting to be told a dependency has slipped.

Stakeholder management and delivery accountability

* Act as the trusted point of contact for European Finance leadership, Controllers, Shared Service Centres and country Finance teams; communicate design trade-offs, timelines and constraints in business language.
* Manage expectations honestly on scope, cost and date — including saying no, or not yet, with a reasoned alternative.
* Own the plan and the date: baseline it, track it, report status without varnish, and land releases on time with no unmanaged surprises at cutover.
* Protect the financial close calendar — no release, cutover or freeze-window decision that puts month-end, quarter-end or year-end close at risk.
* Represent the Finance product in change advisory boards, architecture forums and release governance.

Required Skills & Experience

* 10–14 years in SAP with strong hands-on functional depth in FICO — GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Banking, Taxation, Product Costing, CO-PA, Intercompany, period-end close. S/4HANA experience expected.
* Proven track record of owning solution design and delivering change through a third-party system integrator (Accenture, TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, IBM or similar) — managing their solution managers and developers, not just receiving their output.
* Demonstrated experience in a large global FMCG/CPG environment of large scale — multi-country, multi-company-code, multi-currency, global template with local statutory variance, high transaction volumes, complex trade and promotional accounting.
* Strong integration literacy: able to write and challenge an interface requirement, understand SAP BTP / Integration Suite (CPI) patterns, IDocs, APIs and events, and debug integration issues alongside technical teams.
* Cross-module fluency across FI/CO to MM, SD, PP, and to reporting and consolidation layers; able to spot the downstream impact of a Finance design decision.
* Product management discipline: backlog and roadmap ownership, prioritisation frameworks, requirement writing, release planning, benefits tracking.
* Delivery methods: Agile/Scrum and SAFe alongside stage-gated project delivery; comfortable with Jira or Azure DevOps and with ServiceNow-based change governance.
* Change and release governance: ChaRM / Solution Manager / Cloud ALM, transport discipline, CAB, emergency change protocols, audit-ready traceability.
* Excellent written and spoken English; ability to influence senior Finance stakeholders and hold a partner to account without escalating everything.

Good to Have

* Experience with Central Finance, Group Reporting, Universal Journal, or a Finance transformation/S/4 conversion programme.
* European statutory, VAT/e-invoicing, and local compliance exposure (e-invoicing mandates, SAF-T, Intrastat)

---------------

Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team builds software to improve customer experience by : (1) Enabling Agentic Shopping experiences through World Product Catalog that contains all shoppable products sold anywhere in the world, (2) Growing number of customer relevant brands and products on Amazon, and (3) enriching product and brand information in Amazon catalog. **Position Overview**  
  
The **Senior Product Owner** is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.  
  
This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding & Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player-manager who both delivers and develops.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

  

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

  

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

  

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day-to-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

  

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Team Development**

  

* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role)**  
  
Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:

  

* Core HCM, Onboarding & Workday Help: Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.
* Compensation & Advanced Compensation: Salary structures, merit and bonus plans, compensation cycles, equity, allowances, and global pay practices.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products become agentic and ambient. TCI's AI Enablement & Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make data classification, handling, and retention enforceable and provable rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we build the AI-driven automation and internal products that take operational load off the whole organization, so builders spend their time creating trust instead of maintaining it by hand.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own the product vision and roadmap for this work. You will define the internal products, paved paths, and automation that make data governance provable and that measurably reduce operational burden across every charter. You will translate a broad, ambiguous mandate into a clear product strategy, decide what to build and in what order, and turn it into shipped capabilities that other teams adopt because they are genuinely better and faster. This is a technical product role: you will operate close to data systems, enforcement mechanisms, and AI automation, and you will be expected to reason about the architecture and trade-offs, not just the surface. You will work across engineering, science, product, privacy, and legal, and you will influence teams beyond your own to adopt the standards you set.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the charter's data governance and AI enablement products.
* Define the internal products and paved paths that make data classification, handling enforcement, and retention provable, and make adopting them the easy default for other teams.
* Own the product direction for AI-driven automation that reduces operational burden across charters, and define how its impact on capacity is measured.
* Write the narratives and requirements that align leadership and partner teams, and represent the charter in cross-organization reviews.
* Partner with engineering and science to make build-versus-adopt and automation trade-offs, and to hold governance and compliance guarantees as product requirements rather than afterthoughts.
* Prioritize ruthlessly across a broad surface, balancing compliance obligations, operational-efficiency gains, and partner-team needs.
* Define and track the metrics that prove governance is enforceable and that automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to steer the roadmap.
* Partner with privacy and legal to translate obligations into product requirements that builders can adopt by configuration.
* Influence and align teams beyond your own to build to the standards and paved paths you define.

Who We Are:  
Trust CX Innovations is a strategic innovation team within Amazon Devices & Services that focuses on advancing AI technology while prioritizing customer trust and experience. Our team operates at the intersection of artificial intelligence, privacy engineering, and customer-centric design.

To pioneer trustworthy AI innovations that delight customers while setting new standards for privacy and responsible technology development. We aim to transform how Amazon builds AI products by creating solutions that balance innovation with customer trust.

* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience in regulatory frameworks and policy analysis methodologies
* Experience delivering large, cross-functional, customer facing products
* Experience with explainable machine learning and artificial intelligence methodologies and tools
* Experience analyzing data to make business decisions

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields

A/B testing and experimentation

Operating at the intersection of supply chain operations, enterprise IT, and digital innovation, this individual will own the technical roadmap for our core data creation and maintenance platforms (specifically Syniti / DSP and its complex integrations into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).

* Material Master Domain Leadership Tool Ownership: Act as the technical and operational authority for the global Material Master data model in our stewardship tools. You will ensure these systems operate with high reliability, comply with rigid data standards, and evolve through structured releases to support complex supply chain and manufacturing activities.
* Process Automation Workflow Re-engineering: Partner with Global Data Steward Leads, Quality, and IT teams to systematically transition stewardship activities from manual, high-touch execution to intelligent, streamlined, and automated workflows.

As a senior technical leader within the Hyderabad Tech Center, you will leverage local technical talent while maintaining global alignment to drive operational excellence, GxP compliance, and modern automation practices (including generative AI and workflow orchestration).
  
  
What Will You Do in This Role
  
  
1. Material Master Data Domain Governance Platform Ownership
  
  
**Govern the Material Master Data Model:** Serve as the technical custodian for the Material Master data structure within our stewardship tools, ensuring a deep understanding of master data dependencies, taxonomy, and downstream impacts on manufacturing and logistics.
  
**Own the Tooling Ecosystem:** Act as the Technical Product Owner for data creation, change management, and validation tooling (such as Syniti/DSP and associated middleware connecting into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
  
**Align Business Logic with Tech:** Translate complex Material Master requirements (e.g., global vs. local views, Plant/Storage Location parameters, Bill of Materials (BOM) configurations, and regulatory metadata) into precise technical specifications and tool rules.
  
**Backlog Release Management:** Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, feature prioritization, and release roadmaps in close coordination with IT delivery engineers, architecture teams, and global business stewards.
  
  
2. Process Re-Engineering, Simplification Automation
  
  
**End-to-End Material Workflow Optimization:** Deep-dive into existing material stewardship processes (such as first-time material code creation, changes, and plant extensions) to eliminate manual bottlenecks, redundant pre-checks, and handoff delays.
  
**Intelligent Automation Delivery:** Design, evaluate, and implement automation solutions across the material lifecycle, utilizing business rule engines, automated validation scripts, API integrations, and low-code orchestration platforms.
  
**AI GenAI Integration:** Spearhead the practical adoption of generative AI (e.g., Gemini) and machine learning capabilities to assist data stewards in automated data validation, material request interpretation, anomaly detection, and auto-generated documentation.
  
**Industry Best Practices:** Benchmark external master data management (MDM) and supply chain automation frameworks to keep our operating model forward-looking and scalable.
  
  
3. Quality, GxP Compliance Data Integrity
  
  
**Quality Validation Partnership:** Partner closely with Quality Assurance, Computer Systems Validation (CSV), and Regulatory teams to ensure all tooling enhancements, automation bots, and scripts meet strict GxP and audit standards.
  
**Automated Data Quality Controls:** Build automated, GxP-compliant data governance pre-checks, validation rules, and mandatory approval workflows directly into the tooling UI to enforce data integrity at the moment of entry.
  
**Audit Readiness Traceability:** Ensure full lifecycle traceability, change control documentation, and audit trail reliability for all automated and system-assisted data operations.
  
  
4. Global Partnership, Location Synergy Team Upskilling
  
  
**Bridge IT and Stewardship Operations:** Serve as the primary technical liaison in Hyderabad, connecting local IT/software product development with global data stewardship leaders and supply chain operations.
  
**Drive Change Adoption:** Partner with Global Data Leads and operational managers to design rollout plans, training materials, and change-management programs for new automated ways of working.
  
**Technical Mentorship:** Foster an automation-first culture across the Hyderabad stewardship hub, coaching team members on digital tools, prompt engineering, and automated testing practices.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Data Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

**Experience:**  

* 8 years of progressive experience in Master Data Management (MDM), Technical Product Ownership, Business Systems Analysis, or Enterprise Data Solutions.
* Strong functional background in SAP Material Master (MM) operations, with a clear understanding of supply chain, procurement, and manufacturing data flows.
* Substantial experience operating in a regulated enterprise environment (pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or medical devices preferred).

* Tool Ownership MDM Platforms: Hands-on technical experience with master data creation and governance platforms, preferably Syniti (DSP) or comparable enterprise MDM/governance suites.

title: Director, Product Management AI Quality & Evaluation
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

We ship AI into workflows where being confidently wrong is expensive. A banker builds a pitchbook from generated tombstones and charts. A portfolio manager acts on AI-generated attribution commentary, and an analyst asks a conversational assistant a question and gets back an answer synthesized across filings, transcripts, estimates, news, and their own firm's internal data. In each case the output looks finished, and it carries FactSet's name into work a client will act on.

When AI gets something wrong in these workflows, the cost is contractual and reputational, and in some cases regulatory. The error does not stay inside our product. It travels into a client's own work product and into the decisions they make from it.

AI has moved from a feature inside a few products to a capability across the platform, and our quality practice needs to scale with it. Teams have built their own test sets and their own working definitions of good, which is how most organizations start. At platform scale, conversational assistance , banker workflows, portfolio commentary, research management, and the APIs clients build on top of each need their own measures of quality, evaluated on shared tooling so the results can be compared and audited in one place.

This role exists to build that function. You will define the quality and evals playbook for AI at FactSet, own the platform that measures it, and make it straightforward for every team to prove the quality of what they build. You are the first product hire into this charter, and you will build the team behind it.

**What you will own**

**Own the evaluation platform.** You are the product leader for FactSet's shared AI evaluation platform, paired with an engineering counterpart who owns the technical build and operation. Together you stand it up and run it as enterprise infrastructure: tracing, offline and online eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge pipelines with calibrated human review, golden dataset management, and regression suites wired into CI. You own the roadmap, the adoption strategy, the integration surface into product teams' existing workflows, and the commercial and roadmap relationship with the platform vendor. Your engineering counterpart owns the technical relationship. You will know it worked when your colleagues across the enterprise run their own evals on it without your team in the loop.

**Define the golden pathways.** With your engineering counterpart, develop and maintain the golden pathways for evaluation across the enterprise: the documented, opinionated way a team instruments a system, builds a dataset, runs an eval, and wires it into their release process. A product team should be able to follow the paved path without designing an evaluation approach from scratch, and you own keeping those pathways current as practice and tooling change.

**Define how quality is measured.** Define the quality taxonomy for AI systems across the portfolio: what a failure is, how failures are classified, and which failure classes are non-negotiable, plus the further classes you define with product leadership and with the PMs who own each capability. This becomes the shared language the organization uses to argue about quality, and you are its steward.

**Own human review operations.** Evaluation at scale depends on people producing labels on a schedule: judge calibration sets, ground-truth datasets, and adjudication of disagreements. You own that operation, including how reviewers are sourced, trained, and measured for consistency, what it costs, and how it scales as coverage grows. Your engineering counterpart builds the tooling those reviewers work in.

**Set and hold the floor.** You define the minimum every AI capability must satisfy before it reaches a client. The floor is a coverage requirement: a capability ships with evals defined and running, tracing in place, a documented failure taxonomy, and a measured baseline it can be held against later. Product teams set their own quality targets above that line and are expected to aim well above it.

**Drive adoption.** Enterprise platform mandates fail when the platform is slower than the spreadsheet it replaces. You will land this team by team: understand what each product group does for quality today, help them move onto shared tooling and pathways, and make the shared path the easier one. This is a sustained internal go-to-market effort and a core part of the job.

**Close the loop from production.** Design the path from a client-reported failure to a permanent regression test. The program succeeds when the same failure cannot ship twice. That matters far more than the number of evals in existence.

**Unite the practice.** Bring evaluation leaders at FactSet together into a small group of PMs and specialists operating as a federated center of excellence. You own the standard and the platform, and product teams own their own quality outcomes against it.

**What we are looking for**

* 10+ years in product management, with 4+ years on AI/ML or data-intensive products, and experience managing product managers

* Demonstrated experience defining evaluation methodology for LLM or ML systems: metrics, failure taxonomies, golden datasets, and quality thresholds that engineering teams actually adopted

* Experience taking an internal platform from zero to broad adoption across product teams who were not required to use it, including the migration, enablement, and change-management work that entails

* Experience operating a paired product and engineering leadership model, where neither person has authority over the other's function

* Hands-on fluency with modern evaluation approaches, including offline and online eval, LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop review, RAG and retrieval metrics, and agent trajectory evaluation, enough to design a pipeline and critique someone else's without needing to implement it

* Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith , LangFuse , Braintrust, or Weights & Biases. We care that you have opinions about this category rather than experience with any one product in it

* A track record of standing something up rather than inheriting it. You have built a function, a standard, or a platform from nothing inside a large organization

* Comfort holding a bar under commercial pressure, and the judgment to know when the bar is wrong

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders across time zones without formal authority over their teams

* Strong written communication. This role produces standards documents that people have to be able to follow six months later

**Helpful, not** **required** **:** financial services or capital markets domain knowledge; experience with regulated or audited AI deployments; familiarity with model risk management practice.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You’ll Do**

In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.

Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency.

**Who you will work with**

On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.

**What makes you a qualified candidate**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.

* 12+ years of product management experience, including 6+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers

* Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

* Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.

* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.

* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.

* Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities.

**What you will bring**

* Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time

* Hands-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e.g., Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR).

* Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware.

* A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage.

* Vision to anticipate industry trends, next-generation backup architectures, AI-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
